title: Product definition outlining known Versions and Components
description: Defines the structure for a Product object, including its versions and associated components.

schema_t.title: OpenEoX Lifecycle schema
schema_t.description: Specifies the schema the JSON object must be valid against.

Product.description: Represents a product with its name, vendor, versions, and components.

product_acronyms.description: A list of acronyms that represent the the product.

prio_product_names.description: A list of prior names that product has used or gone by.

vendor_name.description: The name of the vendor for this product.

versions.description: List of versions for this product.

components.description: List of components associated with this product.

Version.description: Represents a specific version of a product, referencing lifecycle phases from the main schema.

name.description: The name or identifier of the version.

release_date.description: The GA (general avalabilty) date of the version (YYYY-MM-DD).

weight.description: A weight value for the version allowing for ordering when the version used doesn't follow symantic versioning.

Component.description: Represents a component, an included product or dependency that included/associated with a product.

name.description: The unique name of the component within the product.

product_ref.description: References the product name or definition that defines this component as a product.
